summary: Frontend-only visual/functional regression of the refined mobile app (/m) at 390x844 in light and dark themes, logged in as demo owner (gb-in-app removed, verified null). Home, the bottom nav, Manage (all 8 tabs), Profile, Attendance and logout all work. No horizontal overflow on any screen (scrollWidth=390), and no white-on-light contrast problems were found. One real UX bug: when you switch tabs from the bottom nav, the page keeps the previous scroll position instead of going back to the top.

ui_bugs.issue: There is no scroll-to-top on navigation. If you scroll Home to the bottom (scrollY=447) and tap Profile, Profile opens at scrollY=447. Attendance opened at scrollY=570, past the hero and quick actions, so users land mid-page and miss the header and summary cards. Nothing in /m resets window scroll (only Legal.jsx calls scrollTo).

issues: The 'Payment' and 'Renewals' quick actions, and the 'Members with dues' and 'Expiring today' rows, all go to the same /m/manage?tab=members with the 'All' chip selected. Consider passing a filter (e.g. ?chip=due / expiring) so each shortcut lands on the matching list. This behaviour existed before and is not a regression.

These still use separate bordered cards per row, while Members, Home and Profile now use the grouped m-group list. The visual language is inconsistent. Staff status chips are lowercase ('disabled', 'active') while member chips are capitalized ('Expired', 'Active').
The version text 'GymBoss_VVO · v1.0.0' uses text-muted-foreground/60, which is very low contrast on the light background (decorative, minor).
The date const `today` in Home.jsx is computed once at module load. If the PWA stays open past midnight it shows yesterday's date. Move it inside the component.

action_items: Add a ScrollToTop effect in MobileLayout (useEffect on pathname -> window.scrollTo(0,0)) so bottom-nav and quick-action navigation start at the top of the page.
Optional: make the Home shortcuts deep-link to a member filter chip (due / expiring).
Optional: convert Staff and Attendance lists to the m-group grouped style and capitalize the staff status chip labels for consistency.
Optional: compute the Home date inside the component.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx: `today` is a module-level const, so the date goes stale in a long-lived PWA session.
Members.jsx is 391 lines and still mixes the list, the add sheet and 5 action sub-views. Consider splitting it into MemberActionsSheet.
MobileLayout has no scroll restoration or reset on route change.
verified_passing: Login /m/login works for demo@gymbossvvo.in and lands on /m/home
Home header: date 'WEDNESDAY, 21 OCT', 'Hi, Demo', 'Iron Paradise Fitness', m-trial-badge 'Trial · 6d' goes to /m/profile
m-theme-toggle switches the html.dark class both ways
m-today-card shows ₹14,300, Online ₹12,000, Cash ₹2,300, Joined 7, with good contrast in both themes
All 4 quick actions navigate correctly; Add Member opens m-member-sheet
Needs attention (9/0/3) and At a glance (9/26/14) rows navigate correctly (enquiries row goes to the enquiries tab, check-ins to /m/attendance)
m-txn-list shows exactly 5 rows; m-onboarding is hidden (all steps done)
Bottom nav: the correct item gets m-navitem-active on every route. The last item on Home, Members and Profile is reachable above the nav (bottoms 754, 770 and 755 vs nav top 779)

Manage: segmented tabs readable in both themes; 26 m-member-<id> grouped rows; a row opens the actions sheet (renew/payment/reminder/history); m-members-add opens the sheet; plans/enquiries/expenses/outlets/staff/finance/reports tabs all render without overflow

Profile: grouped sections Your gym / Appearance / Account; m-change-password and m-delete-account open sheets; m-privacy-link=/privacy; m-support-link points to wa.me; the plan picker (m-plan-monthly/quarterly/yearly) and m-pay-button are present on web; m-theme-light/dark work; m-logout goes to /m/welcome
Attendance renders the hero, QR/Biometric/Manual tiles, the Members/Staff seg and the list in both themes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme is set via localStorage 'gb-theme' (light|dark|system). Make sure 'gb-in-app' is removed. Demo data includes TEST_ prefixed members/staff from earlier iterations. To check the scroll-reset fix: scroll Home to the bottom, tap m-nav-attendance, and expect window.scrollY==0.
